title: Programmable proteases designed to cut any chosen site

concept.text: Millennium Problems for Biology 8, Programmable proteases. Target: within 24 hours, design a protease that efficiently cleaves a blinded site in a folded protein in living cells; the full challenge is 20 preregistered sites at over 80% success; cleaving preregistered peptides in solution counts as partial success. Sources given: https://millenniumproblems.bio/.

change_log.change: Added by hand to BCH on 2026-11-15.
change_log.reason: One of the twelve Millennium Problems for Biology (Sam Rodriques and Michaela Hinks, FutureHouse and Edison Scientific, 2026), each with a stated concrete target; added at the owner's request, November 14, 2026.
